attacker_action: Call withdraw(victim, 100) from a fresh account with zero balance. The call succeeds and 100 sample tokens move to the caller.
description: Invented sample data, not a real finding. The withdraw function checks the caller's balance instead of the named user's balance, so any caller can withdraw another user's funds.

evidence.detail: Foundry proof of concept run on a local fork: fresh account with zero balance called withdraw(victim, 100) and received 100 sample tokens; victim balance fell by 100.

impact: Any user's full vault balance can be drained by any caller with no account and no funds of their own.
note: Invented sample data, not a real finding.
title: Sample Vault withdraw lets any caller drain another user's balance
